summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. furnished a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026, with a single exhibit: its 2026 Interim Report, signed by CFO Huiping Yan. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer interim results disclosure under the 1934 Act, containing no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event. No special situation is present; there is no deal term, valuation, ownership split, regulatory clock, or risk-arb angle to assess.
